The plate is a square side plate, roughly 20-22 cm across. The carrot pile covers about 8 cm by 7 cm, or roughly 12% of the plate. The shreds are thin and loosely piled, about 1-1.5 cm high, so the pile is about 50 cm² × 1 cm, or ~50 cm³. With air gaps, the packing density is around 0.4 g/cm³, which gives about 20-25 g. A couple of stray pieces add a few grams. I estimate about 25 g in total.
